label: Layoff Trap · Retail banking · Nash α (2027)
prompt:
Branch + back-office automation in US/EU retail banks.

What automation rate α will firms in Retail banking reach by end of 2027 under the Nash equilibrium of the Falk–Tsoukalas closed-form model?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to BLS automation-share figure (industry table) reported for 2027-Q4, mapped onto the model's α parameter via the `extract_firm_params` calibration.

diagnostics.label: Symmetric-firms assumption
diagnostics.note: Firms in a sector treated as symmetric (closed-form requires it).

diagnostics.label: Demand elasticity
diagnostics.note: Sector-specific elasticity extracted from cosmos seed; refresh when filings update.

diagnostics.label: Cross-sector spillovers
diagnostics.note: Out of scope for the closed-form single-sector solver.
